statement: Schematic closure quotient over Z and its narrow-class extension have generic fibre S_m for the real-place modulus.
depends_on: Anantharaman1973 Thm4.C; Serre1968 II.1.3 and II.2.2
notes: Closure is schematic, not profinite; model need not be a torus at ramified primes.

statement: The literal reflex-norm-only formula for the exact Frobenius element is false; algebraic Hecke-character and ideal/slopes formulation is correct.
depends_on: MilneCM2020 Thm8.1,9.3,9.10; CCO2008 Thm5.1
notes: Counterexample: y^2=x^3-x and y^2=x^3-4x over Q(i), good at5, opposite Frobenius traces.

statement: Good reduction Frobenius gives a point of the special fibre of the integral Serre group and hence the asserted gerbe bridge.
depends_on: Tate motive Q(-1)
notes: For k=Q the group is Gm and Frobenius p is not in Gm(Z_p); moreover coefficient base Q differs from special-fibre base F_p.

statement: The corrected reduction morphism is Mot_ab(Fbar_p)^vee -> CM(Qbar)^vee over Q, bound by P -> S, with LR local conditions.
status: Proved under stated CM Hodge input (Theorem I of the opened 2026 preprint)
depends_on: Milne2003 section7; vanHoftenSempliner2026 ThmI
notes: The local conditions alone leave the inverse-limit class-group ambiguity of Milne2003 Thm7.2; no canonical comparison with an unspecified LR representative asserted.

statement: For every simple A0/F_q some power A0^m is F_q-isogenous to good reduction of a CM abelian variety with full CM action over a number field and residue exactly F_q.
depends_on: CCO2008 Thm1.6=Prop5.4; Honda-Tate; explicit local/global/type construction
notes: Independent root audit passed; exact slope convention and number-field full-action conclusion verified in opened primary source.

statement: Every exact algebraic p-unit Weil number in Gamma_q is a good-reduction eigenvalue of a tensor CM motive with residue exactly F_q.
depends_on: D.1.power_lift; Honda-Tate; roots, tensors and Tate twists
notes: Varying number field and CM data is essential. The exponent m is unrestricted; this does not claim simple isogeny classes themselves always lift.

statement: The simple F4 surface with pi=2*zeta5 has no normal CM lift over residue F4, whereas its square does.
where_proved: D.1 immediately before and after lem:d-power-cm-lift
depends_on: Oort2009 Example3.3 and Thm4.4; CCO2008 RRC
notes: End0=Q(zeta5); all reflex fields have residueF16. For square use Q(zeta5,sqrt(-3)) and type induced from Q(sqrt(-3)).

statement: For absolute-Hodge and motivated motives of abelian type, commutative G_mot identity component is equivalent to membership in the Artin/potentially-CM-abelian category.
depends_on: Deligne1982Hodge Thm8.25; Andre1996 Thm0.6.2 and section6.3
notes: Full faithfulness, CM Hodge category, finite descent and induction are supplied.

statement: For general motives the same classification is equivalent to the explicitly stated CM comparison case of the absolute-Hodge/motivated Hodge conjecture.
status: Exact equivalence proved (truth of the conjectural comparison not asserted)
depends_on: Deligne1982Hodge Conj8.24; established abelian full faithfulness
notes: This is the general-case output explicitly allowed by the question. It is not the unrestricted Hodge conjecture and is not implied by CM Hodge classes alone.

statement: Metabelian motivic Galois groups are exactly the Taniyama quotient groups.
depends_on: Deligne1982Taniyama main theorem p262; Deligne1982Hodge Prop8.17
notes: h0(Spec Q(alpha)), alpha^4-alpha-1=0, has group S4, a nonmetabelian Taniyama quotient. Correct metabelian category is Rep(T/closed T-second-derived), within CM motives.

statement: Two embeddings give the Taniyama-fibre comparison torsor, changed CM type, and canonical finite-adelic comparison.
depends_on: Deligne1982Hodge Prop8.23c,d; Deligne1982Taniyama main theorem; MilnePedestrians Thm1.1,1.3
notes: No canonical rational Hodge isomorphism is falsely asserted; explicit lattice and polarization formula is included.

statement: Sha^1_f(Q,S^K) is the even-sum subgroup of F2^{[K+:Q]}, and restriction to H1(R,S^K) is an isomorphism.
depends_on: Milne2003 Eq23 Lemma3.1 Prop3.2; Brauer reciprocity
notes: All-places kernel is zero; finite-place kernel has 2^(r-1) elements.

statement: For the full geometric CM category with fields inside finite Galois CM K, finite-local-compatible Q-fibre-functor forms form a torsor under Sha^1_f(Q,S^K).
depends_on: D.3.kernel; Tannakian torsor classification; R2 integral generation
notes: Arithmetic Artin data and smaller subcategories require their actual group and cannot silently be replaced by S^K.

statement: Betti is singled out by finite comparisons for every K.
depends_on: D.3.kernel; quaternion local invariants
notes: It is unique iff [K+:Q]=1; F=Q(sqrt5), K=F(i) gives the nontrivial class (-1,-1)_F.

statement: These H1 ambiguities are not the H2(mu2) nonneutrality obstruction of the finite-field motivic gerbe.
depends_on: Tannakian torsors versus gerbe obstruction
notes: Real forms of an existing fibre functor are H1; existence is H2. Adding the real comparison kills the finite-place ambiguity.

statement: The image torus has X*=Z^{I_E}/ker(A^t), X_*=(imA tensor Q) cap Z^{I_E}, and dimension rank_Q A.
depends_on: Split torus character/cocharacter duality
notes: Cocharacter saturation is necessary; full norm-compatible torus iff rank=g+1, equivalently only pair-sum row relations.

statement: The image of the type norm is the Mumford-Tate group of the CM type, including degenerate types.
depends_on: MilneCM2020 Prop1.23 Prop4.19 Cor4.7; minimal rational torus containing Hodge cocharacter
notes: No nondegeneracy hypothesis.

statement: The compact image is ker(nu) in the image torus, has rank_Q A-1, and character lattice im(A^t)/Z*ones.
depends_on: D.4.image; pair-sum identity; primitive ones vector
notes: The scalar and compact factors intersect in mu2; no false integral direct-product decomposition.

statement: For abelian Galois CM E, rank is 1 plus the number of nonzero odd-character type sums; this determines all full-image cases.
depends_on: Fourier diagonalization of convolution matrix
notes: Examples include full quadratic/quartic/sextic and degenerate induced/biquadratic types.

statement: The standard Serre character lattice, integral generation by all CM types, factorization of type norms and reflex degree bound used in D are valid.
depends_on: background reading sections1.2-1.3; Milne-Shih1982 section1; explicit lattice basis
notes: Fixed finite-modulus quotient may have extra finite unit quotient and need only be isogenous to the standard connected Serre torus.

statement: The norm-one-torus finite-place kernel is the even real-sign group, and agrees with that of S^K.
status: Used and rechecked with missing bridge proved
depends_on: background reading section1.4; cyclic norm/Brauer sequence; D.3.kernel
notes: U and S^K are different tori; 1->Gm->S^K->U->1 supplies the comparison.

statement: The narrow-class idelic formula and real de Rham fixed-form condition are correct.
depends_on: background reading section1.5; class field valuation sequence; real Betti-deRham comparison
notes: The cover reading metabeliens cannot be visually confirmed because scans were not supplied; its naive group-theoretic slogan is refuted by D.2.b.

statement: Integral special-fibre Frobenius bridge as stated.
status: Refuted; integral model and correct Q-gerbe bridge proved
depends_on: D.1.integral through D.1.all_weil
notes: Strong exact Weil-number determination completed, rather than stopping at the special-fibre counterexample.

statement: The slogan identifies metabelian motives with Taniyama quotients.
depends_on: D.2.a.abelian; D.2.a.general; D.2.b; D.2.c
notes: Potentially CM + Artin is correct Taniyama category, not all quotient groups are metabelian.

statement: R3 controls CM fibre-functor ambiguity.
status: Proved with precise Serre-torus and category formulation; uniqueness claim refuted when r>1
depends_on: D.3.kernel; D.3.forms; R3.used
notes: Computed actual S^K cohomology, not merely the norm-one torus.
